intro.title: Get to Know AKAF Group
intro.paragraph1: AKAF System began its operations in 1988 in Gorgan, Golestan Province, Iran, focusing on developing computer software for accounting and management. After successfully developing and launching several software products and gaining the satisfaction of dozens of clients, the company was officially registered as 'Arman Kabir Andisheh Forouzan' with registration number 7346.
intro.paragraph2: In 2003, the company was recognized as the top software design company in Iran and received the Golden Medal of IT Elite. This achievement is a testament to the quality and innovation of AKAF System's products and services.
intro.paragraph3: Today, AKAF System has become a trusted and reputable partner for factories, companies, and business centers across the country by designing and developing dozens of specialized software, websites, and applications.
intro.paragraph4: In line with expanding its international activities and after a successful experience in Turkey, AKAF System decided to expand its operations in the Gulf countries. Accordingly, in 2023, by establishing a new office in Muscat, the capital of Oman, under the name 'AKAF Investment & Integrated Projects', it expanded its international activities in the fields of industrial robotics, AI-based software, and business application development.

IndustrialPage.title: AKAF Industrial — Industrial Engineering & Factory Solutions
IndustrialPage.description: AKAF Industrial is the industrial engineering division of AKAF: feasibility studies, factory development, production lines, machinery sourcing, automation, and commissioning.
IndustrialPage.headline: AKAF Industrial
IndustrialPage.intro: AKAF Industrial is a credible, commercially independent industrial engineering operation. It supports investors and factory owners through the full lifecycle — from feasibility and engineering to machinery, installation, and operational readiness.

smartCta.title: Build a connected factory

IndustrialPage.processSubtitle: Our delivery model covers the full industrial lifecycle — each stage offered as a general capability and scoped per project.

SmartIndustryPage.title: AKAF Smart Industry — From Factory Floor to Management Intelligence
SmartIndustryPage.description: AKAF Smart Industry is the cross-division collaboration model connecting AKAF Industrial engineering with AKAF Digital software — manufacturing digitalization, IT/OT integration, and industrial analytics.
SmartIndustryPage.headline: AKAF Smart Industry
SmartIndustryPage.tagline: From Factory Floor to Management Intelligence
SmartIndustryPage.intro: Smart Industry is a collaboration model between AKAF's two divisions — not a separate company. AKAF Industrial engineers the physical factory; AKAF Digital connects it to enterprise software, dashboards, and applied analytics.
SmartIndustryPage.exampleSubtitle: A plastics injection molding factory with multiple production machines — how a potential engagement could be delivered.

steps.title: Factory & production-line engineering
steps.description: AKAF Industrial plans the factory, layout, and production line configuration.

steps.title: Machinery sourcing, installation & commissioning
steps.description: Injection molding machines are sourced, installed, and commissioned with technical evaluation.

steps.title: Production-data acquisition & connectivity
steps.description: Machine, vehicle, and production data are collected and connected — including automated weighbridge and plate-recognition workflows — subject to each site's technical assessment.

steps.title: ERP, inventory & production management integration
steps.description: AKAF Digital integrates production data with ERP, inventory, and production management workflows.

steps.title: Operational dashboards & manufacturing KPIs
steps.description: Factory owners and operations directors gain dashboards for output, downtime, quality, and cost indicators.

steps.title: Analytics & AI-assisted decision support
steps.description: Applied analytics and AI-assisted tools support planning, maintenance, and operational decisions.

SmartIndustryPage.scopeDescription: Capabilities such as ERP connectivity, dashboards, and production monitoring are standard offerings. Connectivity to specific machines, PLC models, or legacy equipment is evaluated per project and confirmed after technical assessment. We do not claim universal PLC compatibility or fully autonomous industrial control.

WeighbridgePage.title: AI-Powered Automated Weighbridge Management System — AKAF Digital
WeighbridgePage.description: Deployed industrial software for automated weighbridge operations: AI-assisted vehicle handling, ANPR plate recognition, gate control, and operational monitoring — used in more than 60 factories.
WeighbridgePage.headline: AI-Powered Automated Weighbridge Management System
WeighbridgePage.subheadline: Automated weighbridge operations with AI-assisted vehicle handling — deployed in more than 60 factories outside Oman.
WeighbridgePage.overview: The system automates industrial weighbridge operations end to end: vehicle identification, license plate recognition, gate and barrier control, verification workflows, vehicle entry logs, and operational monitoring — reducing manual gate work and improving throughput and accuracy.
modules: Vehicle entry logs and audit trail
WeighbridgePage.imageAlt: Weighbridge management interface — AIS Integrated weighbridge module
WeighbridgePage.imageCaption: Interface view of the AIS Integrated weighbridge module. Module-level features shown may vary by deployment; request a demo for details.
WeighbridgePage.deployment: Deployed in more than 60 factories outside Oman through the founder-led software engineering operation.
WeighbridgePage.tech: The platform supports camera-based ANPR workflows, barrier and gate hardware integration, ERP connectivity, and configurable verification rules per site. Integration scope is assessed per deployment.
WeighbridgePage.ctaDescription: See the weighbridge system in action and discuss deployment for your facility.
